import { Controller, Inject, Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import {
  ClientProxy,
  ClientsModule,
  EventPattern,
  MessagePattern,
  MicroserviceOptions,
  Payload,
  Transport,
} from '@nestjs/microservices';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import { Entity, PrimaryColumn, Repository } from 'typeorm';

const USERS_CLIENT = 'USERS_CLIENT';

@Entity('user_event')
class UserEventEntity {
  @PrimaryColumn()
  declare id: string;
}

@Injectable()
class UsersPublisher {
  constructor(@Inject(USERS_CLIENT) private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-colocated-user-created
  publishCreated(id: string): void {
    this.client.emit('user.created', { id });
  }

  // D0_CASE:microservices-colocated-get-user
  async requestUser(id: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.client.send({ cmd: 'get_user' }, { id }));
  }
}

@Controller()
class UsersMessageController {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(UserEventEntity)
    private readonly events: Repository<UserEventEntity>,
  ) {}

  @EventPattern('user.created')
  async userCreated(@Payload() payload: { readonly id: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.events.save({ id: payload.id });
  }

  @MessagePattern({ cmd: 'get_user' })
  getUser(@Payload() payload: { readonly id: string }): { readonly id: string } {
    return { id: payload.id };
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: USERS_CLIENT, transport: Transport.RMQ }])],
  controllers: [UsersMessageController],
  providers: [UsersPublisher],
})
class UsersMicroserviceModule {}

void NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(UsersMicroserviceModule, {
  transport: Transport.RMQ,
});

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 Nest microservices fixture must never execute: colocated');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
